items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: I went to talk with him. I asked him, I said, Well, I think you can make a good planet player.

ctx.x: What's up with Michael? What do you think of your... You know, I mean, I'm sorry to entice him. They get a plan there. Yeah. Because you see he was playing. He was playing flute one day. One of them little fights. That's right, yes. And I passed that and I hold that and I stopped looking. I said, Oh, this fella can play on some fight. So, I went to talk with him.
